title: Cold rebuild: a user name validator that holds
summary: Rebuild IsValidUsername from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: You wrote **IsValidUsername** in *Validate the whole input*. Now write it again from an **empty editor**: no
starter, no hints, no solution. The tests are the ones you passed the first time.
Remember the two traps: `IsMatch` finds a part, and `$` accepts a trailing newline. If you get stuck, go back to
the lesson and try again tomorrow.

steps.prompt: Warm up. What does this print?
steps.explain: `$` matches before the final newline, `\z` does not. Without an anchor at the end, `bob!` passes because `bob` is a match.

steps.title: Rebuild IsValidUsername cold
prompt: Write `bool IsValidUsername(string name)`: true only when the whole name is 3 to 16 characters of lowercase ASCII
letters, ASCII digits and `_`, starting with a letter. No trailing newline, nothing after it.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
